description: Open roles from one company's public Greenhouse job board (pass its board token, e.g. airbnb or stripe). Title, location, posted time, apply link. Greenhouse does not give salary here; one company per call. Related tools on this server, for a different need: jobs_ashby_jobs_board when you need open roles from one company's public Ashby job board; jobs_teamtailor_jobs when you need open roles on one company's public Teamtailor career site. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
